name: UvVenv
description: Create a virtual environment with uv and optionally sync dependencies
helpMarkDown: Create a virtual environment with uv and optionally sync dependencies
author: Henry Daniel Mosquera

inputs.name: venvPath
inputs.label: Venv path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Relative to the working directory. An existing venv is reused unless 'Recreate if it exists' is on.

inputs.name: pythonVersion
inputs.label: Python version
inputs.helpMarkDown: uv python request (`3.12`, `pypy@3.10`...). Empty = UV_PYTHON (set by UvPython) or .python-version or the interpreter uv finds. uv downloads it if needed.

inputs.name: syncMode
inputs.label: Dependencies
inputs.helpMarkDown: How dependencies are installed into the venv.

inputs.name: syncArgs
inputs.label: Extra uv arguments
inputs.helpMarkDown: Appended to `uv sync` or `uv pip install -r`. Examples: `--frozen --all-extras --group dev` (project) or `--index-url https://feed/simple` (requirements).

inputs.name: activate
inputs.label: Activate for following steps
inputs.helpMarkDown: Sets VIRTUAL_ENV and UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT and puts the venv bin/Scripts folder first in the PATH, so `python`, `pip`, `uv sync` and `uv run` use it in the following steps.

inputs.name: autoInstallUv
inputs.label: Install uv if missing
inputs.helpMarkDown: If uv is not found, download it (same logic as the UvSetup task). Disable on locked-down agents and run UvSetup / pre-bake uv instead.

inputs.name: uvVersion
inputs.label: uv version
inputs.helpMarkDown: Only used when uv has to be installed. `latest` or an exact version such as `0.8.0`.

outputVariables.name: venvPython
outputVariables.description: Absolute path of the venv interpreter
